C1511.title: Security and Privacy Analysis of Extended Reality Devices
C1511.summary: In February 2024, an academic paper presented a device-centric analysis of security and privacy attacks and defenses targeting extended reality (XR) devices, emphasizing the need for robust and privacy-aware security mechanisms to protect XR hardware and outlining future research directions and design considerations.
